name: Jesaiah
overview: The name Jesaiah, also rendered Jeshaiah, appears in Scripture as belonging to several individuals connected to the post-exilic community of Israel. These include a Jew from the family of Elam who returned with Ezra from exile, a Levite associated with the family of Merari, and a Benjamite descended from Jesaiah, who was chosen by lot to reside in Jerusalem after the exile. Collectively, these references highlight Jesaiah's role within the restoration and reestablishment of the Jewish people in their land, emphasizing God’s faithfulness in preserving His covenant community through diverse family lines.
